name: text/marker-highlight
title: Marker Highlight
title_vi: Nét bút dạ vẽ lên từ nhấn mạnh
desc_vi: Dòng chữ nổi lên, rồi một nét bút dạ vẽ tay chạy qua từ cần nhấn mạnh, từ đó nảy nhẹ khi mực chạm.
params_vi: word: từ cần nhấn (khớp đầu tiên, không phân biệt hoa thường) · style: highlight | circle | underline | scribble · accent: màu mực (#71f5a7) · drawAt: lúc bắt đầu vẽ (0.9 s) · draw (0.6 s) · exit: none | fade | up · exitAt
notes: Motion and the four stroke paths are the source's (viewBox, path data, stroke widths 26 / 2.8 / 4.5 / 5, ink opacities 0.5 / 1 / 1 / 0.65, the per-style boxes around the word, preserveAspectRatio none). Timings: rise 0.55 s power3.out from 6 % of the frame height (65 px), draw 0.6 s power2.inOut at drawAt (0.9 s, relative to the effect start), pop to 1.045 over 2 x 0.16 s at 70 % of the draw, ink hidden (opacity 0) until the cue, exit fade / up 0.45 s. Differences: the source's variables text/emphasis_word become the target's own text and the param `word`; the source's text block (max-width 86cqw, centring, 600 weight, font fitting) and background belong to the film; the ink colour is a param (default the source's green fallback #71f5a7, no theme tokens). The dash length is measured with getTotalLength at build time and written as a literal. The source's envelope depends on the clip duration D (default 3.5 s) and compresses phases when D is short; here exit is off by default and exitAt (3.05 s = 3.5 - 0.45) is a param; with an exit, drawAt is clamped so stroke and pop finish before it, as in the source. The check 'end' is disabled: the final frame carries the drawn marker, so it intentionally differs from the plain text layout.

elements.text: Chốt phim với sự tự tin
